note: [L] proves both minimizing choices real analytic near 0 (`scheme` by the real-analytic implicit function lemma, `prediction_cont` through the nearest projection); the frame quadratic part av|h_x-h_y|^2/2, its positive definiteness on h_0 = 0 and the predictor Hessian I are not stated.

lemma scheme (i : S.patch.Points) : ContDiffAt ℝ ω (fun v : In G f => hats S y t v i) 0 := by
  let a := hats S y t (G:=G)
  let F := uncurry (fun x u => plant S y (x,u)) (α:=In G f)
  have hk : ContDiffAt ℝ ω F (0,a 0) := by
    refine contDiffAt_pi.mpr fun v => ?_
    unfold F uncurry plant
    dsimp only
    split
    · exact ((contDiffAt_apply ℝ G.Mat v _).comp ((0:In G f),a 0) contDiffAt_snd).sub contDiffAt_const
    apply ((contDiffAt_apply ℝ G.Mat v _).comp ((0:In G f),a 0) contDiffAt_snd).sub
    have hh : ContDiffAt ℝ ω (fun x => G.mat (G.focus x)) (cloud S y (0,a 0) v)  :=
      by rw [show cloud _ _ _ _=1 from cloud_zero S y t (h:=h) _]; exact G.focus_diff
    exact hh.comp (f:=fun p => cloud S y p v) ((0:In G f),a 0) (cloud_form S y v (a 0))
  have hx : ∀ᶠ x : In G f in 𝓝 0,F (x,a x)=0 := by
    filter_upwards [roots S y t (G:=G), eventually_all.mpr (stars S y t (h:=h))] with x hx hh
    funext i; change plant _ _ _ _=_; unfold plant; split
    next hi => rw [hi]; simp [a,hx]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (hh i)
  refine (contDiffAt_apply ℝ G.Mat i _).comp 0 (authored a F 0 hx (continuousAt_pi.mpr fun i => hat_cont S y t (h:=h) i) hk fun u H => ?_)

proof_context.conclusion: The frame choice `hats` is real analytic near 0: the self-consistency equation `plant` (a nearest-point fixed point of the averaged `cloud`) is analytic and the real-analytic implicit function lemma `authored` applies with a trivial-kernel derivative.

lemma lips (t : S.Choices) : ∀ᶠ x : In G f in 𝓝 0,
    S.prediction (represent x) t e = G.focus (bonds S e t.1 x) := by

proof_context.conclusion: Near 0 the predictor equals `G.focus` (nearest projection) of the weighted average `bonds` of the connectors.

lemma prediction_cont (t : S.Choices) : ContDiffAt ℝ ω (fun v : In G f => G.mat (S.prediction (represent v) t e)) 0 := by
  refine ContDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq (f:=fun v => G.mat (G.focus (bonds S e t.1 v))) ?_ (by
    filter_upwards [lips S h e t] with i hi; rw [hi])
  have hh : ContDiffAt ℝ ω (fun u => G.mat (G.focus u)) (bonds S e t.1 (0:In G f)) := by rw [bonds_zero _ h]; exact G.focus_diff
  have he : ContDiffAt ℝ ω (bonds S e t.1 (G:=G)) 0 := by
    unfold bonds; apply ContDiffAt.sum; intro i _; exact (builds S h e t.1 i).const_smul (S.patch.weight i)
  exact hh.comp (f:=bonds S e t.1) 0 he

proof_context.conclusion: Hence the predictor `S.prediction (represent v)` is real analytic at 0.
